sources.title: Downloading and using prebuilt toybox binaries.webm

selection: Seven named new instructional sources selected using official Commons title/size/author/license metadata before viewing or scoring. Three Toybox videos share one author; seven recordings are not seven independent creators. Convenience exploration, no representative recall.
rule: For each original, prepare 12 seconds at floor(min(duration-12,600)*q) for q=.25,.5,.75. This covers distinct points in the app-supported first ten minutes, avoiding duplicated capped timestamps on long recordings. Retain all 21 outcomes. Never add a defect. Inspect proposals for teaching meaning before independent HTTP export qualification.
phase: Frozen v5 baseline; later source-driven fixes are development, not held-out validation.
